subject: Private control plane: IdP federation & SCIM sync — on‑prem cutover playbook
messages:
From: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@globex.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: IT Integrations <idp-team@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Integrating Globex IdP with Redwood private control plane — initial details

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this on. We are preparing the on‑prem private control plane cutover for Q1 and want to align on IdP federation and account provisioning. High level we need:

- SAML SSO for admin console access (IdP initiated + SP initiated)
- SCIM for group and role provisioning into the private control plane
- A clear model for delegating admin roles from our existing AD groups to Redwood RBAC
- Audit evidence for certificate rotation and provisioning logs (SOC2 ask)

Can you share the preferred assertion attributes (email, groups, role mapping) and the SCIM attribute mappings you expect? Also attaching our internal diagram and one question: will Redwood accept IdP metadata with multiple signing certs (we rotate quarterly)?

Attachments: globex-idp-overview.pdf (external)

Best,
Olivia
IT Security Lead — Globex Corp
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@globex.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 17:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Integrating Globex IdP with Redwood private control plane — initial details

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes, we support both IdP and SP initiated SAML flows for the private control plane; SCIM 2.0 is supported for groups/users; we accept metadata with multiple signing certs and recommend using the metadata URL for rotation.

I attached a short requirements doc that lists the SAML attributes we consume and a suggested SCIM mapping table. Key points:

- SAML attributes we require: email (NameID or mail), given_name, family_name, and groups (as a multi‑valued attribute). For role binding we recommend a groups->RBAC mapping (see table).
- For delegated admin we support a supergroup claim ("redwood_admins") or an attribute mapping that maps to an IAM role ARN on private hosts.
- SCIM: we prefer group externalId => RBAC role id, and keep profile attributes minimal (displayName, emails, externalId).
- Cert rotation: support metadata URL and validation of key rollover; we also accept manual X509 blob upload if your IdP cannot host metadata.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick technical sync (30m) next week to confirm attribute names and test IdP metadata.
2) We exchange test metadata and a small test SCIM group.
3) Plan a canary cutover on a two‑node private control plane before wide rollout.

Attachments: redwood-idp-requirements.pdf

If that works, Laura and Aditya are on this thread to sign off on delegated admin mapping and audit evidence.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@globex.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Integrating Globex IdP with Redwood private control plane — initial details

Thanks Karthik. A couple of operational guardrails from our side:

- Delegated admin mapping: we prefer mapping to explicit RBAC roles (Owner, Admin, Operator) rather than freeform group names. Please include a mapping table in the SCIM spec.
- Audit logs: we'll capture SAML assertion validation events and SCIM provisioning events — we need to confirm retention window with Globex security (default 90 days, longer available as an enterprise option).
- Canaries: recommend a phased approach (dev -> staging -> prod) with a rollback plan.

Action items: Karthik to propose exact attribute names + a minimal SCIM sample payload; Olivia to provide IdP metadata URL and a test user/group.

Laura Bennett
Director, Cloud Security — Redwood Inference
From: IT Integrations <idp-team@acme.com>

Subject: Re: Integrating Globex IdP with Redwood private control plane — initial details

Hi all —

Olivia sent the metadata URL and a test bundle: https://idp.globex.com/metadata.xml . Confirming a few specifics from our engineers:

- We rotate signing keys quarterly; metadata contains two active certs during rollover windows.
- SCIM endpoint requires a client certificate for mutual TLS (mTLS). Is Redwood able to connect via mTLS for SCIM provisioning to a customer‑controlled endpoint?

If mTLS is required, we can provision a client cert for Redwood for the canary. Please advise on preferred TLS ciphers and client cert format (PEM preferred).

Thanks,
IT Integrations (on behalf of Globex)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: IT Integrations <idp-team@acme.com>, Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@globex.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jan 2028 15:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Integrating Globex IdP with Redwood private control plane — initial details

Thanks — good questions. Short answers:

- Multiple active certs in metadata: supported. We validate the certificate chain and accept any valid active signing cert. We prefer metadata URL but support uploaded XML.
- mTLS for SCIM: we support mTLS for outbound SCIM clients when customers host an inbound endpoint; alternatively Redwood can host SCIM and accept inbound provisioning via TLS + basic auth. For Globex on‑prem we recommend mTLS with PEM client certs (RSA 2048+ or ECDSA P-256), and we will share the expected PKCS#7 chain format for our client cert.
- Certificate rotation: our rotation playbook supports overlapping cert validity (we will test a key rollover in the canary). We will produce an audit artifact that lists assertion subject, assertion ID, validation result, and timestamp for each SAML transaction.

I uploaded a draft SCIM mapping spreadsheet and a federation diagram to the shared Drive (links above). Proposed 30m test window: Thurs 2028-01-19 15:00 UTC. Can you confirm?

Attachments: scim-mapping-spec.xlsx, federation-diagram.png
Related: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xq-example-drive-id

—Karthik

- Exchange test metadata + client PEM for mTLS
- Validate SAML login (IdP init + SP init) with two test users
- Run SCIM group push of a single role (redwood_admins) and validate RBAC binding
- Execute a certificate rollover trial on non‑prod cluster and check audit artifacts

We will capture the runbook in the private control plane runbooks folder and notify security for the SOC2 evidence pull.

Laura
